headline: Start Aaron Jones over Quinshon Judkins at FLEX before Sunday 10:00 AM PT kickoff — Jordan Mason's move to IR (Sept 16) hands Jones the clear Vikings backfield lead in a far better spot.
summary: Danny is 1-0 and mostly set; the one real lineup call is swapping newly-added Aaron Jones in for Judkins, who draws an 8.5-point road dog spot. Burrow (back tightness, limited Wed) and Juwan Johnson (illness, DNP Wed) are both Questionable — Burrow still expects to play, but Johnson has no bench TE cover if he doesn't practice Friday.

lineup.why: Jordan Mason (MIN) went to IR Sept 16, clearing Jones as the lead back with passing-down work in a plus game script (implied 22), while Judkins is an 8.5-point underdog in a 16.5-implied game.
lineup.evidence: Jones: room lists him RB1 with Mason now inactive/IR; DK Network (Sept 16) reports Mason to IR ~4 weeks, Jones out-snapped him 30-29 in Week 1 and projects toward a 60% share with more passing-down work as Minnesota is expected to throw more. Judkins: room still lists him CLE RB1 ahead of Sanders/McLaughlin with no injury, but Cleveland is an 8.5-point underdog at Tampa Bay (implied 16.5), the specific game-script spot the playbook downgrades a runner in.

subs.why: Burrow (back tightness) was limited at Wednesday's practice but says he expects to play Sunday; set Willis as his AutoSub before the 10:00 AM PT kickoff as free insurance.

Johnson (illness) did not practice Wednesday and Danny carries no other rostered TE, so there is no eligible AutoSub; if he isn't a full participant by Friday, decide yourself by about 8:30 AM PT Sunday (90 minutes before his 10:00 AM kickoff).
